mapper.select: SELECT oi.item_id AS itemId, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(oi.num, 0)), 0) AS itemNum FROM community_order_rel_activity AS rel INNER JOIN orders_normal_orders AS ord ON rel.order_id = ord.order_id LEFT JOIN orders_normal_orders_items AS oi ON ord.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE rel.activity_id = #{activityId} AND ord.order_status IN ('PAYED', 'WAIT_BUYER_CONFIRM', 'DONE') AND ord.cancel_status IN ('NO_APPLY_CANCEL', 'FAILS') GROUP BY oi.item_id HAVING oi.item_id IS NOT NULL

SELECT oi.goods_id AS goodsId, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(oi.num, 0)), 0) AS buyNum, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(oi.total_fee, 0)), 0) AS totalFeeCents, COALESCE(MIN(COALESCE(ci.min_delivery_num, 0)), 0) AS minDeliveryNum FROM orders_normal_orders_items oi INNER JOIN orders_normal_orders AS ord ON oi.order_id = ord.order_id INNER JOIN community_activity ca ON ca.activity_id = #{activityId} INNER JOIN items it ON oi.item_id = it.item_id LEFT JOIN community_items AS ci ON it.goods_id = ci.goods_id AND ci.company_id = ca.company_id WHERE ord.order_type = 'normal' AND ord.order_class = 'community' AND ord.act_id = #{activityId} AND ord.order_status = 'PAYED' AND ord.cancel_status IN ('NO_APPLY_CANCEL', 'FAILS') GROUP BY oi.goods_id

SELECT oi.goods_id AS goodsId, COALESCE(SUM(COALESCE(oi.num, 0)), 0) AS buyNum, COALESCE(SUM(CAST(COALESCE(oi.item_fee, 0) AS DECIMAL(20, 2))), 0) / 100 AS totalFee FROM orders_normal_orders_items AS oi INNER JOIN orders_normal_orders AS ord ON oi.order_id = ord.order_id INNER JOIN community_activity AS ca ON ca.activity_id = #{activityId} INNER JOIN items AS it ON it.item_id = oi.item_id INNER JOIN community_items AS ci ON ci.goods_id = it.goods_id AND ci.company_id = ca.company_id WHERE ord.order_class = 'community' AND ord.act_id = #{activityId} AND ord.order_status IN ('PAYED', 'WAIT_BUYER_CONFIRM', 'DONE') AND ord.cancel_status IN ('NO_APPLY_CANCEL', 'FAILS') GROUP BY oi.goods_id
